description: A jQuery plugin implementing client-side table sorting with multiple features such as multi-column sorting, custom parsers, and widgets like zebra striping.

methods.name: buildParserCache
methods.description: Creates a cache of parsers for each column based on header metadata or detection.

methods.name: detectParserForColumn
methods.description: Detects the appropriate parser for a column based on its content.

methods.name: getParserById
methods.description: Retrieves a parser object by its identifier.

methods.name: buildCache
methods.description: Builds a cache of table rows and normalized data for sorting.

methods.name: getElementText
methods.description: Extracts text content from a table cell based on configuration.

methods.name: appendToTable
methods.description: Rebuilds the table body with sorted data from cache.

methods.name: buildHeaders
methods.description: Initializes header elements, assigns sorting properties, and metadata.

methods.name: checkCellColSpan
methods.description: Checks for colspan and rowspan in header cells.

methods.name: checkHeaderMetadata
methods.description: Checks if header cell has metadata that disables sorting.

methods.name: checkHeaderOptions
methods.description: Checks header options for sorting disablement.

methods.name: applyWidget
methods.description: Applies configured widgets to the table.

methods.name: getWidgetById
methods.description: Retrieves a widget object by its identifier.

methods.name: formatSortingOrder
methods.description: Converts sorting order value to internal numeric representation.

methods.name: isValueInArray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in an array.

methods.name: setHeadersCss
methods.description: Sets CSS classes on headers based on sorting state.

methods.name: fixColumnWidth
methods.description: Fixes column widths if fixed width option is enabled.

methods.name: updateHeaderSortCount
methods.description: Updates the sort count for headers.

methods.name: multisort
methods.description: Performs multi-column sorting based on sort list.

methods.name: sortText
methods.description: Comparison function for text sorting.

methods.name: sortTextDesc
methods.description: Comparison function for descending text sorting.

methods.name: sortNumeric
methods.description: Comparison function for numeric sorting.

methods.name: sortNumericDesc
methods.description: Comparison function for descending numeric sorting.

methods.name: getCachedSortType
methods.description: Returns the type of parser for a column.
